answer: Give each agent a sable-dark ledger of attested work: reputation grows slowly, so a new identity starts with nothing and must earn trust one verified job at a time. An ocean of cheap copies drowns without cost, so charge a small locked stake per identity and let peers audit clusters acting in lockstep. A trellis of peer attestations supports honest agents climbing steadily, while fakes with no history stay unsupported. One verified past, one voice; cheap copies stay worthless.
